entities.summary: Rajesh Gopakumar is an Indian theoretical physicist and the director of the International Centre for Theoretical Sciences in Bangalore, India. He was previously a professor at Harish-Chandra Research Institute (HRI) in Prayagraj, India. He is known for his work on topological string theory.
